name: Forus S.A.
summary: Forus S.A. engages in the design, development, marketing, and distribution of footwear, apparel, accessories, and beauty/personal care products in Chile, Peru, Colombia, and Uruguay. It offers its products under the CAT, RKF, Columbia, Under Armour, PARFOIS, Merrell, BSoul, VANS, Hush Puppies, Crocs, L'OCCITANE en Provence, Azaleia, and Norseg brand names. The company serves its customers through sales channels which include physical stores, e-commerce websites, and wholesale and third-party marketplaces.
